# Nintendo Switch OLED Starter Buying Guide & Retailer Comparison

This buying guide is based on live checks of official Nintendo technical specifications and support documentation, alongside live product pages across **Amazon**, **Target**, and **Walmart**.

---

## Part 1: Official Nintendo Switch OLED Compatibility & Hardware Rules

Before purchasing accessories, verify these official hardware specifications from Nintendo’s technical documentation:

1. **Screen Size & Factory Film (7.0 Inches vs. 6.2 Inches)**
   * **The Difference:** The Switch OLED features a 7.0-inch display, whereas the standard Nintendo Switch has a 6.2-inch display and the Switch Lite has a 5.5-inch display. Screen protectors made for the standard Switch **will not fit** the OLED model.
   * **Official Warning:** Nintendo pre-installs an "Anti-Scattering Adhesive Film" over the OLED glass at the factory to prevent glass splintering if dropped. **Do not attempt to peel this film off.** Third-party tempered glass screen protectors are designed to adhere directly on top of this film.
2. **Console Dimensions & Full-Width Kickstand**
   * The Switch OLED measures **4.0" H × 9.5" W × 0.55" D**, making it approximately **0.1 inches wider** than the original Switch (9.4").
   * The back features a full-width adjustable kickstand. Snap-on hard shell cases designed for the original narrow kickstand will block the OLED stand. Carrying travel cases must accommodate the extra 0.1-inch width.
3. **microSD Storage Specifications**
   * **Supported Types:** microSD (up to 2 GB), microSDHC (4 GB–32 GB), and microSDXC (64 GB–2 TB).
   * **Recommended Performance:** UHS-I (Ultra High Speed Phase I) compatible with read transfer speeds between **60 and 95 MB/s** (higher transfer speeds improve game load times).
   * **Crucial Rule:** Game save data is saved exclusively to the internal console storage (64 GB on OLED) and **cannot** be copied or saved to a microSD card. MicroSD storage is used for downloadable software, updates, DLC, and media captures.
4. **Power & Docking Profiles**
   * The official Nintendo Switch AC Adapter outputs **5.0V / 1.5A (7.5W)** and **15.0V / 2.6A (39W)** over USB Type-C.
   * The OLED Dock strictly requires a **15V / 2.6A USB-PD profile** to initiate TV-out mode. Standard 5V phone chargers can slowly charge the console in handheld mode while asleep, but will not power TV dock mode.
5. **Controller Compatibility**
   * Joy-Con controllers (L/R) and the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller are universally compatible across all Nintendo Switch models.

3. **ivoler 4-Pack Tempered Glass Screen Protector with Alignment Frame for Switch OLED**

   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** Offers 4 tempered glass protectors plus a physical auto-alignment frame tool for under $9, providing the most backup units if you share the console with kids.

### Category 2: Carrying Cases (Must Accommodate OLED 9.5" Width)

   * **Why Pick It Over Others:** The gold standard for home console gaming. It delivers unmatched ergonomics, premium sticks and buttons, full feature parity (HD rumble + amiibo), and an industry-leading **40-hour rechargeable battery life**.

**Buy Bundle 2: The Balanced Everyday Starter Bundle.**

1. **The Switch OLED already has 2-player multiplayer built-in:** The system ships with two detachable Joy-Cons, so you do not need to purchase extra controllers right away to play with a friend.
